issues.finding: CONFIRM reads aux_model_audit.json for actual48000/8/32 eligibility, but that file is absent from source_CONFIRM required inputs. Freezer only inserts registry/base inputs, so the audit consumed by the producer need not be bound by the actual source_CONFIRM Git contract.

issues.finding: Unvalidated stage is interpolated directly into open(...,w) log paths. Absolute or parent-traversal stage can write outside the new RUN before Popen; run/pub ancestor symlinks are not rejected before lock/log writes.
issues.fix: Reject unsafe stage names and confine/validate output ancestor paths before any directory/queue/log mutation; add pure/temp-path refusal fixtures.

issues.finding: No pre-Popen actual storage-cap check. A child exiting before .05sec bypasses polling; final storage probe records an over-cap upper but never checks it, so stage_exit_status can return0 and another stage can launch after the hard limit. Late actual CPU/wall/GPU amounts similarly need final postcondition checks.
issues.fix: Under queue lock, enforce current storage upper before launch; after directly waited final probes and exact CPU/wall sampling, evaluate actual applicable resource/deadline caps and retain a failing raw record if violated.
